title: &bBestiary
subtitle: The Huntmaster's ledger: ranks, traits, and every kind of thing that bites.

quests.title: &6Know Thy Enemy
quests.subtitle: Read it before it reads you.
description: &o"Every monster out there has a level, a rank and a temper. Two of those you can read."&r &7— the Huntmaster
Ring a spyglass with four &6Remnant Shards&r and you have a &6Hunter's Lens&r. Held, it tells you how dangerous the area is. Look through it at a monster to read its level, rank, traits and stats.

quests.title: Elite
quests.subtitle: Blue crest. Two traits.
description: Ranks climb &7Common&r, &fVeteran&r, &9Elite&r, &5Champion&r, and finally &cRemnant&r. Every rank adds traits and pays more Valor.
About one monster in seventy is an &9Elite&r. Slay one, and look at what dropped.

quests.title: Champion
quests.subtitle: Purple crest. Three traits. Bad news.
description: One monster in three hundred is a &5Champion&r. Not the gold-titled kind that carries Sovereign Fragments; that's a different curse. This one is just bigger, meaner and better paid.
Get close enough to read its three traits, then decide whether you're staying.

quests.title: &cA Remnant's End
quests.subtitle: It has a name. It has a horn.
description: Past level 30, a very few monsters rise as &cRemnants&r: named echoes with a title, a boss bar and a horn you can hear from nearly fifty blocks off. They never despawn. They remember.
When one falls, the whole world hears about it. Make sure it's your name in the message.

quests.title: Nothing Left to Hide
quests.subtitle: Four traits on one monster.
description: Some monsters wear every trick they've got at once. &6Four traits&r on a single body: the rarest ranks carry that many, and a Brand of Challenge can add the last one.
Kill one. Then sit down for a bit.

tasks.title: Slay a monster with four traits

quests.title: Under the Red Moon
quests.subtitle: Some full moons are not for sleeping.
description: On about one full moon in three, a toll sounds and the &cHunter's Moon&r rises. Until dawn, monsters spawn five levels stronger, ranks come twice as often and shards drop double.
An icon on your screen means it's up. Hunt under it, or bar the door. Both are reasonable.

tasks.title: Slay a ranked monster under a Hunter's Moon

quests.title: Punching Up
quests.subtitle: Ten levels above you, and still standing. Briefly.
description: A monster's level shows in colour against your own. The redder it is, the worse your odds and the better the pay: kills above your level give half again the Valor.
Kill a ranked monster at least ten levels above you.

tasks.title: Slay a ranked monster ten levels above you

quests.title: Accept the Challenge
quests.subtitle: Make it worse. On purpose.
description: An echo shard ringed with eight Remnant Shards makes a &6Brand of Challenge&r. Use it on a monster and it climbs one rank, gains five levels and one more trait.
Its rewards double. So does everything else about it.

quests.title: Blood, Venom and Frost
quests.subtitle: Traits that follow you home.
description: &cVampiric&r: heals for part of what it deals. Don't trade blows; every hit you take feeds it.
&2Venomous&r: poisons. Champions and Remnants poison harder. Carry milk or honey.
&8Withering&r: withers you. Back off before it stacks up.
&bFrostbite&r: slows and freezes you, and can't be frozen itself. Fight it on open ground.
&6Infernal&r: immune to fire, and sets you ablaze. Leave the fire weapons at home.

tasks.title: I know which traits bleed me

quests.title: Hard to Kill
quests.subtitle: Traits that keep it standing.
description: &bWarded&r: a shield of absorption that regrows if you leave it alone. Keep the pressure on.
&aRegenerating&r: steadily heals, and fast once out of combat. Retreating to heal helps it more than you.
&2Thornskin&r: melee hits hurt you back. Use a bow, a spell or a sellsword.
&7Juggernaut&r: can't be knocked back, more health and armour, but slower. Walk circles around it.
&fDeflecting&r: projectiles barely scratch it. Draw steel.

tasks.title: I know which traits keep it alive

quests.title: Hard to Pin Down
quests.subtitle: Traits that change the fight.
description: &5Blinking&r: when hit, may appear behind you. Turn around before you swing again.
&eSwift&r: much faster. Don't run; you'll lose.
&cBerserk&r: below half health it hits harder and moves faster. Finish it, or step back and let it come.
&7Crushing&r: knocks you far and breaks shields. Stay away from ledges.
&6Packleader&r: once wounded, calls lesser copies of itself. Kill it fast or fight the pack in a doorway.
&cVolatile&r: explodes shortly after it dies. Step away from the body.

tasks.title: I know which traits change the fight

quests.title: We Want You
quests.subtitle: Guard Villagers. A village that fights back.
description: Villages have &6guards&r now: villagers who picked up a sword when the dark came and never put it down.
Give a sword to a villager with no trade, and you've got another one. Last Light could use the help.

quests.title: The Mound of Hounds
quests.subtitle: Born in Chaos. They hunt in packs.
description: &6Dread Hounds&r run in packs out of the dark, and every pack answers to a &6Dire Hound Leader&r twice their size.
Fight with your back to a wall so they can't circle you. Mind the hound traps around their mounds.

quests.title: A Carnival of the Damned
quests.subtitle: Born in Chaos. The things that walk at night.
description: The dead don't all come back the same. &6Decaying Zombies&r smell worse than they hit. &6Bonescallers&r raise the skeletons you thought you'd finished. And somewhere a caravan of &6Zombie Clowns&r is still on tour.
Kill the caller first. Kill the clown whenever you like.

quests.title: The Hunt That Feeds
quests.subtitle: Naturalist. Deer, boar and bear.
description: Not everything in the woods wants you dead. Deer flee, boars charge, and bears couldn't care less until you're close.
Hunt &6venison&r for the pot and &6fur&r from a bear for the cold. Then leave the rest alone; the world has enough corpses.

quests.title: Lights in the Grass
quests.subtitle: Naturalist. Small things worth keeping.
description: Fireflies are the only lights that still come out at night by choice. Butterflies kept flying through the whole Long Eclipse, out of stubbornness.
Make a &6Capture Net&r and catch one of each. Let them go at Last Light, if you like.

quests.title: Small Kindnesses
quests.subtitle: Friends and Foes. Not everything is hostile.
description: A &6Copper Golem&r presses buttons for you and asks for nothing. A &6Glare&r is a grumpy little moss cloud that hates the dark as much as you do: tame it, and it'll show you the shadows where monsters would spawn.
Build one. Tame the other. Light every place the Glare grumbles at.

quests.title: Teeth and Ice
quests.subtitle: Friends and Foes. The ones that aren't friends.
description: The &6Mauler&r lies in wait in dry country, all jaws and patience. The &6Iceologer&r keeps a cabin in the snow and drops chunks of ice on anyone who visits.
Kill both. Look down for the first, up for the second.

quests.title: Things That Hear You
quests.subtitle: Deeper and Darker. The Otherside.
description: Below the ancient cities, the &6Otherside&r has its own animals, and none of them have eyes.
The &6Shattered&r stalk the echoing forests, &6Sculk Snappers&r bite at anything that makes a sound, and &6Sculk Centipedes&r crawl the deeplands. They all listen. Sneak, and pick your moment.

quests.title: The Hollow Legion
quests.subtitle: The Eclipsed Realm. Soldiers of a hollow king.
description: The Hollow Sovereign's army still drills under the black sun. &6Sentinels&r hold the line, &6Arbalists&r shoot from behind it, a &6Standard Bearer&r keeps them in order and &6Soulbound Knights&r break whatever's left.
Kill the banner first. Armies without one are just crowds. Their &6Tarnished Regalia&r is worth keeping: a Sovereign's Seal needs four.

quests.title: The Buried and the Forgotten
quests.subtitle: The Eclipsed Realm. Cryptborn and Forgotten Souls.
description: In the Gravefield Barrows the &6Cryptborn&r keep house: rats, lurkers and soldiers that never stopped guarding the dead. Elsewhere drift the &6Forgotten Souls&r, pilgrims and wraiths who lost the thread of who they were.
The Cryptborn drop &6Grave Iron&r for a Crypt Key. The souls drop &6Memory Shards&r for a Lens of Memory.

quests.title: Cogs and Shards
quests.subtitle: The Eclipsed Realm. Ashbound and Corrupted Relics.
description: Some things in the Realm were never alive. The &6Ashbound&r are constructs of soot and gears that still keep their posts in the Ashen Wastes. The &6Corrupted Relics&r are worse: old treasures that learned to walk and want to be held again.
They drop &6Ashen Cogs&r and &6Relic Shards&r. Keep both.

quests.title: &aThe Rot That Walks
quests.subtitle: The dead feed the caps. The caps get up.
description: &o"Burn what you kill if it smells of mushrooms. I mean it."&r &7— the Huntmaster

Where the fungus has taken hold, the dead don't lie still: a &aShambler&r is a corpse with &aMycosis&r walking it around. &aBloatshrooms&r swell up and burst into spore clouds, and a &aMimicap&r only looks like a toadstool until you bend down to pick it.
&7Kill a Shambler, a Bloatshroom and a Mimicap. The Mycelial Court (Chronicles of the Ash) tells their story.

quests.title: &cThe Sporemaw
quests.subtitle: All mouth, and the mouth is all spores.
description: The &cSporemaw&r waits burrowed where the caps grow thickest and lobs arcing &cSpore Globs&r at anything that comes close. Hit it three times and it burrows away to try again somewhere else. The Huntmaster pays well for one that stays dead.
&7Kill a Sporemaw. An &6Antifungal Tonic&7 clears Mycosis if it catches you.
